title: Fibroblast regulation of neutrophils in ulcerative colitis: analysis code, source data and figures
description: Version 1.0.1 of the analysis code, derived source data and canonical figures for the manuscript "Single-cell profiling reveals stromal niche and α5β1 blockade regulation of neutrophil phenotypes in ulcerative colitis." The release includes human single-cell and CODEX analyses, fibroblast–neutrophil coculture, DSS colitis interventions, epithelial response programs and independent human validation. It contains 347 data tables, seven main and twelve supplementary figures, two supplementary tables, Methods, data dictionaries, source workflows and a runnable verification of 17 selected reported statistics. Raw sequencing reads, FCS files, whole-slide images, full analysis objects and original model-fitting resources are held separately; upstream workflows require external inputs and configuration. The repository documents the scope and limits of inference. Original code is MIT-licensed; original data tables and figures are CC BY 4.0. Third-party material retains its original terms. This editorial update corrects figure labels and legibility, synchronizes legends, adds verified bibliography and ethics/data-access documentation, and includes the author-provided BioRender graphical abstract with author-confirmed open-access licensing and the supplied BioRender attribution. Analysis code and numerical source data are unchanged from v1.0.0; the CODEX reagent table receives two editorial text corrections.
